verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own referrals feature, which lets the team invite coworkers, investors, and friends to refer candidates to jobs, so the submit side of the flow is first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows the referrer tracking status or seeing where a referral stands in the pipeline. missing for 10: referrer-facing status tracking, visibility into the referral's pipeline stage, detailed referral-flow documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an employee, I can refer candidates through a real referral flow — submit, track status, and see where my referral stands

citations.quote: Invite coworkers, investors, and friends to refer candidates for your jobs.
